n01: Diamond Hands Mine. A quiet community, built on a single rule: never sell the game.
n02: On the night of the fourteenth, the Mine led the Grand Final by a mile. Then, with three seconds on the clock... somebody sold.
n09: Then, a breakthrough. The match replay.
n10: The replay showed nothing. But it was in black and white, so it felt important.
n12: And through it all, one alarm kept going off. Nobody knew whose.
n13: After nine months, forty detectives, and one haunted shopping cart, the throw was traced to a single account. Username: The Narrator.
n13b: Yes. That was me. We were down a round, and I had a reservation.
